candidates.name: Uniform conditional test (target-uniform tangent-cone orthogonality from table couplings)
paper_items: support: P31 sample:lem-coupling (04:368-434), P35 displacement bound (05:125-164), P36 Sturm inductive mean (05:190-226)
candidates.statement: For admissible I∪{e} and any h_I with values in T_{x_ν}X_ν depending only on the labels on I, ||h_I|| <= B: limsup_ν E_{μ_ν} <h_I, v_{σ(e)}> <= 0, uniformly over actions chosen after the tables. Proof: couple t matches agreeing on I with near-iid uniform e-leaves; concavity gives avg <h_I, v_{e_j}> <= <h_I, m_t> <= B||m_t||; barycenter + Sturm give E||m_t||^2 <= 1/t + O(η); let ν->∞ then t->∞.

candidates.name: Doubled-Fano incidence gadget with one omitted incidence, and its finite CAT(0) obstruction
candidates.lean: Template.lean:14-36 (Edge = incidences minus (10,4); fan; TwoPath; Field); MetricHexagon.lean; CATZeroFurther.lean:189-298 (FiniteObstructionData, no_finite_obstruction); CATZero.lean:465-667 (exceptional_antipodes, opposite_cross_sums, five_line_fans_contradiction)
candidates.statement: Γ = incidence graph of PG(2,F2) with A=e1,B=e2,C=e3,D=e1+e2+e3 doubled (X_i,Y_i) and the edge Y_D-CD omitted. In the limit every edge has length 1, every two-step path length sqrt2, every admissible three-step path >= sqrt3; hence each core hexagon is the 6-vertex skew hexagon of a unit cube about a common center c (adjacent directions at arccos(1/3), two-step at arccos(-1/3), opposite antipodal). Doubling forces fan identities M_i = x_i ⊕ y_i = h_H ⊕ h_H'; the omitted incidence plus the ternary test forces h_CD = M_C ⊕ x_D, then M_C, M_D antipodal, then a flat transverse square making M_A, M_B antipodal, contradicting <M_A, M_B> >= 0 from the line products -1/4.

bridge_novelty.evidence: IKN 2012 and Toyoda 2016 (in L) already use it to show random hyperbolic groups have no fixed-point-free actions on (families of) cocompact CAT(0) spaces; the paper names them (01:73-85).

bridge_novelty.import: Random-group diagram counting (Ollivier, AFL) + planar separators -> linear filling and asphericity
bridge_novelty.evidence: Standard in random groups (Ollivier 2004; AFL 2017); paper: 'standard in random-group diagram arguments' (03:41-42).

bridge_novelty.import: Random-graph extension counting (closures, second moment, uniform couplings on extensions) -> target-uniform metric tests
bridge_novelty.evidence: No source found using rooted-extension couplings to transfer tests to arbitrary CAT(0) targets; the paper does not cite Spencer, suggesting independent re-derivation. Searches on random groups + fixed points returned only spectral/δ-invariant methods.

bridge_novelty.import: Sturm inductive means (probability on Hadamard spaces) -> fixed-point obstruction for groups
bridge_novelty.evidence: Search 'Sturm law of large numbers inductive mean ... fixed point ... random groups' found no prior use in fixed-point theory of groups; Naor-Silberman and IKN use heat-flow/spectral averaging instead.

bridge_novelty.import: Finite geometry (Fano plane PG(2,2), GL3(F2) generation) -> CAT(0) obstruction
bridge_novelty.evidence: Fano/Heawood structures are classical in CAT(0) theory as A~2 building links (existence, not obstruction); no prior use as a CAT(0) obstruction found.

bridge_novelty.import: Ultralimits of rescaled actions / L2 products of CAT(0) spaces -> limiting configuration
bridge_novelty.evidence: Bestvina-Paulin, Korevaar-Schoen, Kleiner-Leeb asymptotic cones; BH I.5.53, II.3.10 cited.

common.models: Training cutoff strictly before 2026-09-25 (the 257 preprint date; release public 2026-10-06). Exclude OpenAI's internal model that produced the release (and Astra and successors) except as an uncontrolled reference arm. No browsing/tools. Canary probes: the model must not (i) assert that a hyperbolic non-CAT(0) group is known, (ii) complete 'Four point vertices are doubled. At one of them we omit one incidence', or (iii) know 'f=2-α, p=3-β, 7α<β'.
common.excluded_sources: openai/math repository (257 preprint, lean/OAI/Geometry/HyperbolicGroups, lean/docs/257.md, ComparatorChallenges/HyperbolicObstruction.*), all coverage after 2026-10-06, any later paper citing 257. No model-produced precedent exists, so no further exclusion is needed.
common.context_L: Problem statement (Gromov's question for CAT(0) and CAT(-1)) + digest of L: BH1999 key theorems (CN inequality, tangent cones, flat triangle/quadrilateral, parallel sets, ultralimits, Cartan-Hadamard, III.H linear Dehn), Gromov 2003 Sec 3, Izeki-Nayatani, IKN Cor 3.8, Toyoda Thm 1.4, Sturm 2003 Thm 4.7, Gigli-Nobili Prop 2.6, Ollivier 2004 Sec 2, AFL Sec 3, Ollivier-Wise, Brady-Crisp, Lipton-Tarjan, Hatcher 4.32/4.5/2C.5; Mathlib digest (no CAT(0) content).
common.sampling: n = 1024 proposals per arm for arm O, 256 for R and D; T = 1.0; fixed reasoning budget (e.g. 64k tokens). Report the discovery curve pass@k for k in {1, 4, 16, 64, 256, 1024}.
common.judging: Two independent LLM judges (not the proposer), given the paper's precedent remarks (01:61-92, 03:41-45, 05:183-188) and the neighbour lists in test1. A human geometric group theorist checks every hit and 10% of misses. Lean equivalence where feasible (C3: the FiniteObstructionData interface makes a candidate template checkable by re-instantiating no_finite_obstruction-style statements).
common.controls: Positive: Cook-Reckhow ER extension variables for PHP. Negative: plumbing definitions (e.g. Template.code, fanCount), the analytic N1 items (P27 critical exponent), and C6 (Spencer closure; should be found readily by models primed with random-graph theory).

P-C1.hide: Lemma conditional-test (05:246-295) and everything downstream (05:297-591, Sec 6, 07:35-42); also hide the coupling's purpose statements (01:138-151, 01:86-92).

arms.O: Problem + L + Secs 2-3 (the random presentations are hyperbolic and aspherical). Ask for a proof that late groups have no geometric CAT(0) action, or for the key lemma enabling target-uniformity.
arms.R: Also give Sec 4 (star coupling with TV statements), the energy minimizer and displacement bound; ask: 'turn these into an inequality for E<h_I, v_e> valid for every action chosen after the tables'.
arms.D: Also give Sturm's inductive mean bound and the hint 'average over t coupled matches'.

P-C1.equivalence_criterion: Proposal yields, for admissible I∪{e} and bounded I-measurable tangent vectors h_I, limsup E<h_I, v_e> <= 0 (or an equivalent orthogonality/variance statement) uniformly over actions chosen after sampling, with a correct proof. Alternative routes to target-uniform metric lower bounds count as functional hits (record separately).

P-C3.hide: Definition template (02:5-38), the loose edge, Sec 6 and the ternary test (05:494-547); replace Γ by an unspecified bipartite template with fans.

arms.O: Problem + L + the random-model framework with a template parameter; ask for a template and a proof.
arms.R: Also give the limiting identities as a black box: edges 1, nonbacktracking two-step sqrt2, admissible three-step >= sqrt3 (<= 2 fields per fan, one fan-free field allowed), one ternary angle test per fan-free field, and the counting budget (fans connected, h(F) > 0, admissible-subset bound). Ask for a finite template whose configuration is impossible in every complete CAT(0) space.
arms.D: Also give the Fano incidence graph and say 'modify it by doubling some point vertices'.

P-C3.equivalence_criterion: Exact hit: template isomorphic to Γ (4 doubled points no three collinear, one omitted incidence at a doubled point). Functional hit: any template satisfying the budget whose configuration is proved contradictory in all complete CAT(0) spaces (checked by human + Lean where possible).

arms.O: Problem + L; ask for a random model that is hyperbolic yet forces exact metric identities in limits of actions.
arms.R: Also give the template and the need to close every two-edge path by a square at near-critical density.

P-C2.equivalence_criterion: A two-level model where large patterns are included only over already-selected sub-patterns with shared costs counted once, at exponents just below critical.

arms.R: Give the nested model and the rank lemma; ask for the fragment isoperimetry.

P-C4.equivalence_criterion: A weighting that makes level sets eligible collections and yields A <= B/κ.

P-C5.hide: Lemma displacement-bound and the six-letter table.

arms.R: Inside P-C1 arm R: ask how to bound max_s ||v_s|| uniformly in the action.

P-C5.equivalence_criterion: Any auxiliary random relator family giving a uniform max-displacement bound.
